spanish: No degollarás sobre leudado sangre de mi sacrificio, y no pernoctará a la mañana sacrificio de fiesta del Pésaj.

findings.issue: הַפָּסַח is a common noun with the article. Pésaj leaves that lemma untranslated instead of a Spanish common noun.
a la mañana can be read as time-when (in the morning). ל with יָלִין marks the limit the lodging reaches (to the morning).

notes: Person, number, negatives, construct chain, and repetition of sacrificio otherwise match the tokens.
